trades.audit:
GRADE_Dayton Degenerates: A-
GRADE_noahsaint: B+
WINNER: Dayton Degenerates
ANALYSIS:
Jonathon Brooks is a 23‑year‑old RB for CAR with two completed seasons, while Chris Rodriguez Jr. is a 27‑year‑old RB for JAX with three completed seasons. The younger age and earlier career stage of Brooks generally provide higher long‑term dynasty upside compared to the older, more experienced Rodriguez. Consequently, Dayton received the more valuable asset.

GRADE_Chicken Soup: C-
GRADE_Worthy of my Chuba: B+
WINNER: Worthy of my Chuba
ANALYSIS:
Chicken Soup acquired veteran QB Patrick Mahomes (KC, 31, 9 seasons), RB Chuba Hubbard (CAR, 27, 5 seasons) and a 2028 first‑round pick. Worthy of my Chuba received younger QB Anthony Richardson Sr. (IND, 24, 3 seasons) plus two 2027 first‑round picks and a 2028 third‑round pick. The two 2027 first‑round selections and the younger quarterback provide greater long‑term dynasty upside than the single 2028 first and the older veteran assets.

GRADE_Fire Haslam Into The Sun: A-
GRADE_Chicken Soup: B+
WINNER: Fire Haslam Into The Sun
ANALYSIS:
Fire Haslam received a 29‑year‑old quarterback with six completed seasons and two future third‑round picks (2027 and 2029), providing both immediate and future dynasty value. Chicken Soup received a 23‑year‑old tight end with two completed seasons, offering upside but less proven production. The combination of a proven QB and two picks outweighs the single TE, making the trade favorable to Fire Haslam Into The Sun.

GRADE_MaxWeese25: C+
GRADE_Syracuse Sandstorms: B+
WINNER: Syracuse Sandstorms
ANALYSIS:
Bryce Young is a 25‑year‑old quarterback with three completed NFL seasons for Carolina, while Sam Darnold is a 29‑year‑old quarterback with eight completed seasons for Seattle. The 2028 first‑round pick Syracuse receives far exceeds the value of the 2028 third‑round pick MaxWeese receives, and Darnold’s age limits his long‑term upside compared with Young’s potential. Consequently, Syracuse gains the higher draft asset and a veteran quarterback, giving them the better side of the trade.

GRADE_Chicken Soup: B+
GRADE_spearson22: A-
WINNER: spearson22
ANALYSIS:
Chicken Soup acquired a 2029 first‑round draft pick, which will be made three seasons from now. spearson22 received a 2028 first‑round draft pick, occurring two seasons from now. The 2028 pick is one year earlier and therefore carries greater dynasty value, giving spearson22 the advantage.

GRADE_Dayton Degenerates: C
GRADE_Justin Jefferfather: B
WINNER: Justin Jefferfather
ANALYSIS:
Dayton received tight ends AJ Barner (24, 2 completed seasons) and T.J. Hockenson (29, 7 completed seasons) along with a 2029 4th‑round pick. Justin received a 2027 3rd‑round pick plus 2028 and 2029 4th‑round picks, giving him greater future upside and overall dynasty value.

GRADE_T-Mac Attack: C
GRADE_Justin Jefferfather: B
WINNER: Justin Jefferfather
ANALYSIS:
Jordan Mason is a 27‑year‑old RB with four completed seasons for Minnesota, providing limited upside at this stage of his career. The 2027 Round 3 pick that Justin receives sits one round higher than the Round 4 pick T‑Mac gets, giving Justin two draft assets versus T‑Mac’s single player and a later pick. Therefore Justin’s side captures more dynasty value.

GRADE_noahsaint: A-
GRADE_Justin Jefferfather: B
WINNER: noahsaint
ANALYSIS:
Noahsaint acquired Josh Downs, a 25‑year‑old wide receiver for Kansas City with three completed seasons. Justin Jefferfather received a 2027 second‑round draft pick, a future asset with uncertain placement. The immediate, known production potential of Downs outweighs the speculative value of a next‑year pick, giving Noahsaint the better side of the trade.

GRADE_Dayton Degenerates: A-
GRADE_All Gas No Bench: B
WINNER: Dayton Degenerates
ANALYSIS:
Dayton Degenerates acquire two 2027 second‑round selections, each roughly one year from the draft and offering potential high‑upside talent. All Gas No Bench receives D'Andre Swift, a 27‑year‑old running back with six completed seasons for Chicago. The two future second‑rounders provide greater long‑term dynasty value than a single veteran RB, making the trade favorable to Dayton.

GRADE_All Gas No Bench: C
GRADE_Justin Jefferfather: B+
WINNER: Justin Jefferfather
ANALYSIS:
Emanuel Wilson is a 27‑year‑old RB with three completed seasons for Seattle. The 2028 third‑round pick represents a future mid‑round selection roughly two drafts away. The pick offers higher long‑term upside than the current RB, giving Justin Jefferfather the better side of the trade.

GRADE_Syracuse Sandstorms: C+
GRADE_Justin Jefferfather: B+
WINNER: Justin Jefferfather
ANALYSIS:
Syracuse received WR Amon‑Ra St. Brown, a 27‑year‑old with five completed seasons, plus a 2027 third‑round and a 2028 fourth‑round pick. Justin received RB De'Von Achane, a 25‑year‑old with three completed seasons, along with a 2027 first‑round and second‑round pick. The combination of a younger running back and two high‑value 2027 picks outweighs the veteran receiver and later picks, giving Justin the better side of the trade.

GRADE_MaxWeese25: B+
GRADE_Justin Jefferfather: C+
WINNER: MaxWeese25
ANALYSIS:
MaxWeese25 acquired Tre Tucker, a 25‑year‑old wide receiver with three completed seasons for the Las Vegas Raiders. Justin Jefferfather received a 2028 third‑round and a 2028 fourth‑round pick, both roughly two years away and mid‑round in value. The immediate roster asset of Tucker outweighs two future mid‑round selections, giving MaxWeese25 the better side of the trade.

GRADE_Fire Haslam Into The Sun: C+
GRADE_Syracuse Sandstorms: B+
WINNER: Syracuse Sandstorms
ANALYSIS:
Fire Haslam Into The Sun acquired two young RBs, Quinshon Judkins (23, 1 season) and rookie Jadarian Price (23, 0 seasons), plus a 2028 second‑round pick. Syracuse Sandstorms received a more NFL‑experienced RB, De'Von Achane (25, 3 seasons), along with a 2027 second‑round pick and a 2029 third‑round pick. The combination of a proven back and an earlier second‑rounder gives Syracuse higher dynasty value.

GRADE_noahsaint: C
GRADE_spearson22: B
WINNER: spearson22
ANALYSIS:
Spearson22 received a 2026 third‑round pick plus an additional 2026 fourth‑round pick, while noahsaint only obtained the 2026 third‑round pick. The extra fourth‑round selection gives spearson22 more draft capital and future roster flexibility, making the trade favorable to spearson22.

GRADE_All Gas No Bench: A
GRADE_Syracuse Sandstorms: D
WINNER: All Gas No Bench
ANALYSIS:
All Gas No Bench received two 2026 second‑round picks while giving up only one, netting an additional future draft asset. Syracuse Sandstorms gave up two 2026 second‑round picks for a single one, losing a valuable draft slot. The extra second‑rounder makes the trade heavily in favor of All Gas No Bench.

GRADE_Fire Haslam Into The Sun: B+
GRADE_T-Mac Attack: B-
WINNER: Fire Haslam Into The Sun
ANALYSIS:
Fire Haslam Into The Sun received 2026 Round 2, 2028 Round 2. T-Mac Attack received 2026 Round 1. On the assets exchanged, Fire Haslam Into The Sun comes out ahead.

GRADE_Dayton Degenerates: D+
GRADE_Worthy of my Chuba: B-
WINNER: Worthy of my Chuba
ANALYSIS:
Deebo Samuel Sr. is a 30‑year‑old WR from San Francisco with seven completed seasons. A 2027 third‑round pick represents a draft asset roughly one year away with potential upside. The pick offers more long‑term dynasty value than the aging veteran, so Worthy of my Chuba received the better side.

GRADE_MaxWeese25: B
GRADE_Mr texas: B+
WINNER: Mr texas
ANALYSIS:
MaxWeese25 receives a 2026 first‑round and a 2026 second‑round pick, which provide high upside in the upcoming draft. Mr texas receives TE Hunter Henry (NE, 31, 10 seasons), RB David Montgomery (HOU, 29, 7 seasons), WR Michael Pittman Jr. (PIT, 29, 6 seasons) plus a 2027 first‑round and a 2026 third‑round pick. The combination of three experienced position players and a future first‑round pick outweighs the immediate two high picks, giving Mr texas the better dynasty value.

GRADE_Mr texas: C
GRADE_Syracuse Sandstorms: B+
WINNER: Syracuse Sandstorms
ANALYSIS:
Mr texas acquired RB Kenny Gainwell (TB, age 27, 5 completed seasons) along with a 2026 first‑round pick and a 2028 third‑round pick. Syracuse Sandstorms received two first‑round picks in 2026 and 2027. The two first‑round selections provide greater long‑term dynasty value than the veteran RB and the later third‑round pick.

GRADE_Syracuse Sandstorms: A-
GRADE_spearson22: B+
WINNER: Syracuse Sandstorms
ANALYSIS:
Syracuse receives a 2026 first‑round pick and a 2028 second‑round pick, providing high‑value assets in the near and mid term. spearson22 receives WR Courtland Sutton (DEN, 31, 8 seasons), RB Rico Dowdle (PIT, 28, 6 seasons), and a 2027 second‑round pick. The first‑round selection gives Syracuse a greater dynasty advantage than the veteran package and later pick received by spearson22.

GRADE_Fire Haslam Into The Sun: C+
GRADE_All Gas No Bench: B+
WINNER: All Gas No Bench
ANALYSIS:
Fire Haslam Into The Sun acquired RB De'Von Achane (MIA, 25, 3 seasons) and a 2027 third‑round pick. All Gas No Bench received WR DeVonta Smith (PHI, 28, 5 seasons) and a 2027 second‑round pick. The combination of a higher‑valued second‑round pick and a veteran WR provides more immediate and long‑term dynasty value than the younger RB and later pick.
